objective: Stop scripts/vendor.ts from deleting every vendored ripgrep and fd file on Windows, so `mise run build` and the pre-commit hook work there.
scope: Known cause and reproduction: in scripts/vendor.ts the cleanup loop `for await (const file of new Bun.Glob("**/*").scan({ cwd: directory, onlyFiles: true })) if (!expected.has(file)) await rm(join(directory, file))` compares Glob results with expectedFiles(), which use forward slashes. On Windows Bun.Glob yields backslash paths, so no file matches and every vendored file is removed; vendorProblems then reports each file missing. Reproduce with `bun scripts/vendor.ts` on Windows after `git restore packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/vendor`: it deletes the files and exits 1. Check other path comparisons in scripts/vendor.ts for the same separator issue.
constraints: Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (Bun APIs, JSDoc on exports, mise tasks).

You may run `git restore packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/vendor` to bring the tracked files back before and after testing; make no other version-control writes, and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/. Report changed paths.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When the work is done and checked, stop and report; do not add unrequested features, tests, files or refactors (name them in the report).

criteria.text: `bun scripts/vendor.ts` on Windows with the tracked vendor files present leaves every tracked vendor file in place, prints the vendored count and exits 0, and still removes a stray file placed in the vendor folder
A test fails on the old comparison and passes on the fix (for example by unit-testing the cleanup with backslash-separated paths, or by running the script against a temporary vendor folder)
`git status --short packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/vendor` is empty at the end
Changes stay within scripts/vendor.ts and its test file
